page.layout: One page of text, verse in roman and italic lines; running head at top centre; page number at top right; faint show-through of the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Peiores licuit cernere Francicas
Matres, credite posteri.

Fraternis maduit caedibus horrida
Tellus, nulla fides nec pietas thori
Seruauere viros, matris ab vbere
Distractus periit puer.

Non seuit catulis Tigris acerbius
Raptis, ira neque est tanta Leonibus,
Quum praedam lacerant unguibus, aut lupus
Pugnas si monet Impares.

Expertus toties Gallica quid fero
Virtus marte queat, nunc posuit metum,
Nunc tantis fruitur cladibus Italus
Gallorum exuviis nitens.

Gallos sique suis vulneribus videt
Attritos, merito miles Ibericus,
Quos olim timuit nunc sine pulvere
Sperat cogere sub iugum.

Securusque tuis Gallia motibus,
Oras splendidior nomen in ultimas
Extendit Dominus, victor & insolens
Cunctis regibus imperat:

Quacunque exoriens sol habitabiles
Terras eximio lumine recreat,
Et quā regna virūm maximè agrestium
Celabat prius occidens.

Armis arua tuis debita possidet
Hispanus, Latiis culta ligonibus,

page.notes: Verse is printed with long s rendered as s; a few words are set in italic throughout. Original printed text reads "Galli", "Italus" and similar as given; no marginal notes. Faint text of the facing page is show-through and omitted.
